text: In the book's Petrov classification, both Schwarzschild and Kerr are algebraically special of Petrov type ___ (their four principal null directions coincide in two pairs, and only Ψ₂ is nonzero).
explanation: The book states Schwarzschild and Kerr are Petrov type D, where the principal spinors coincide in two pairs (α = β, γ = δ) so that only Ψ₂ ≠ 0. By contrast, gravitational waves far from their source are type N, where all four principal directions coincide.
